scope: Eight selected public primary records; no independent experimental replication.

records.readingDepth: Full short agency release, particularly paragraphs on distance/power and efficiency.
records.supported: DARPA reports more than 800 W delivered during a 30-second transmission over 8.6 km. The greater-than-20% efficiency statement concerns shorter-distance optical-input to electrical-output measurements.
records.notEstablished: This release does not report wall-plug efficiency for the 8.6 km run or provide independent raw-data replication. Power comes from an externally powered laser.

records.locator: Official indexed release title/date and search excerpt
records.readingDepth: Official indexed title/date and search excerpt; direct HTML retrieved only a JavaScript shell. Article body not read.
records.supported: The official indexed release dated February 17, 2023 announces $10 million for eight research projects investigating LENR.
records.notEstablished: Funding is not a physical result, disbursement audit, current project completion record or net-gain demonstration. The article body and final award reports were not acquired.

records.locator: Program overview, Exploring the Unknown; observed 2026-10-21
records.readingDepth: Full program overview, including Exploring Advances, Why Fusion Matters and Exploring the Unknown.
records.supported: DARPA describes research into mechanisms that might increase fusion rates in solids; useful power is a conditional future application.
records.notEstablished: Its cited evidence and replication claims remain attributed to DARPA; the underlying papers were not independently reproduced in this records task. No useful net-energy system is documented by the overview.

records.readingDepth: Downloaded original PDF; text read printed/PDF pages 1–8; printed/PDF page 4 visually inspected.
records.supported: The solicitation was posted December 30, 2025, with a March 12, 2026 proposal deadline; it requires falsifiable models and measurements. Page 4 contains a cross-section unit inconsistency: picobarn is paired with 10^-12 cm².
records.notEstablished: Initial solicitation dates do not establish present award status. The literal unit inconsistency must not enter simulations: 1 pb = 10^-36 cm². This correction does not validate or refute the cited experiments.

records.locator: Q24 p. 2, Q17 p. 3, Q4 and Q3 p. 5
records.readingDepth: All five PDF pages opened; focused Q24, Q17, Q4 and Q3.
records.supported: The FAQ says calorimetry alone is insufficient; energy gain is a long-term vision rather than a program metric. A proposed brute-force route must still address trigger efficiency and a path to gain.
records.notEstablished: These are proposal requirements, not evidence that any awardee attained gain. Reaction rates, calorimetry, and net system energy remain different quantities.

records.locator: NTRS document 20040070788; printed pp. 1–5, especially p. 2 result counts
records.readingDepth: NTRS metadata and report abstract, overview, selected task summaries and Casimir discussion; PDF pp. 4–8.
records.supported: The report describes NASA support during 1996–2002 and classifies sixteen tasks from NASA and other sponsors as six nonviable, six unresolved/debatable, and four candidates for follow-up.
records.notEstablished: This is a historical, bounded assessment. Follow-up opportunity is not a demonstrated space drive or energy source, and its bibliography is not automatically verified evidence.

records.stage: historical granted patent; performance not independently verified here
records.locator: Description of Figs. 1 and 3; claims; filing and grant metadata
records.readingDepth: Patent description, claims, metadata and figure descriptions read; original scan linked but not separately compared.
records.supported: Filed March 21 and granted November 5, 1901, the patent describes radiant input charging a capacitor. Its artificial-source variant also identifies a local current source.
records.notEstablished: A patent grant does not validate claimed efficiency or modern microscopic explanations. Incoming radiation, initial stored energy, switches and any local supply belong in the budget. Aggregator legal-status labels are not a current legal opinion.

records.readingDepth: Official 29-page PDF downloaded; PDF pages 1, 7 and 28 OCR-read; pages 1 and 28 visually inspected. Selected passages only.
records.supported: The Army assessment is dated June 9, 1983 and bears a September 10, 2003 release stamp. Inspected passages discuss consciousness, resonance interpretations and proposed future exercises.
records.notEstablished: The inspected passages provide no calibrated electrical-output, calorimetric or closed-cycle energy measurement. Government custody authenticates this record, not its physical interpretations; no conclusion about every related document is claimed.
